title: Backups & restore
subtitle: A world that was played is backed up automatically once a day after its server stops, and again before it is archived after long inactivity. You can use these backups to restore the world — the server must be stopped first.
not_yours_body: Only the owner or an admin can view, restore and delete this server's backups.
history_note: Backups can be restored until they expire, then they are cleaned up automatically. Each server keeps only its most recent manual backups and its most recent scheduled backups (older ones of the same kind are removed once a new one finishes), and its last 3 pre-restore snapshots. Backups you no longer need can be deleted by hand.
reason_released: Archived when given up or deleted
backup_started: Backup started — its progress shows under recent operations below.
backup_world_busy: A backup, restore or world export is already running; back up once it finishes.
backup_requires_stopped: Stop the server before backing it up.
export_world_hint: Download the server's current world as a .tar.gz archive.
export_requires_stopped: Stop the server before exporting its world.
export_world_busy: A backup, restore or export is running on this world; export once it finishes.
export_another: Another download is being prepared; wait for it to start.
export_progress_world: Archiving the world — the download starts by itself once it is ready. Keep this page open; the server can't start until the download ends.
export_progress_backup: Preparing the backup — the download starts by itself in a moment. Keep this page open.
export_started_world: Download started: your browser is saving {{filename}}. The server can start again once it finishes.
export_started_backup: Download started: your browser is saving {{filename}}.
export_failed: The export failed and nothing was downloaded.
empty_hint: A scheduled backup is saved once the server has run and stopped — or create one now with “Back up now”.
jobs_empty: No recent backup, restore or export operations.
chain_pending: Restores the chosen backup once done
chain_abandoned: Not restored; the world was left as it was
chain_abandoned_snapshot_failed: Snapshot failed, so the world was left as it was
chain_abandoned_not_configured: Restore is not configured; nothing was restored
chain_abandoned_server_gone: The server no longer exists; nothing was restored
chain_abandoned_server_started: The server was started before the restore could run
chain_abandoned_restore_busy: Another restore is running on this world
restore_confirm: Restoring a backup will stop the server (all online players will be disconnected) and completely overwrite the current world with this backup. Without a safety snapshot this cannot be undone. Do you want to continue?
restore_confirm_safe: Restoring a backup will stop the server (all online players will be disconnected), take a safety snapshot of the current world, and overwrite the world with this backup once the snapshot succeeds. If you picked the wrong backup, restore the pre-restore snapshot to get it back. Continue?
safety_snapshot_label: Take a safety snapshot of the current world first (recommended)
safety_snapshot_hint: The restore starts once the snapshot succeeds; if it fails, nothing is restored and the world stays as it is.
safety_snapshot_off_hint: No snapshot: the current world is overwritten right away and cannot be recovered.
stopping: Stopping the server (players online get a 30-second warning first)…
stop_timeout: The server did not stop in time. Close this window and try again shortly.
corrupt_hint: A read-back found this archive no longer matches what was written, so it can't be restored intact. It stays listed until it expires so the loss is visible, unless you delete it.
skipped_entries_hint: The world held symlinks or other entries that aren't plain files, so the archive skipped them and a restore won't bring them back.
delete_confirm: The backup from {{relative}} ({{absolute}}, {{size}}) leaves this list at once and can no longer be restored. This cannot be undone.
delete_cleanup_note: Its archive is removed at the next daily cleanup, and its off-site copy at the next sync.
delete_archive_warning: This backup is the archive kept when the world was reclaimed or released. Unless the world on the server has been restored from it, deleting it loses that world for good.
delete_only_warning: This is the only backup this server has.
delete_restore_busy: A restore may be reading this backup. Delete it once the restore finishes.
delete_gone: This backup was already gone; the list has been refreshed.
